(Currently amended) Claim 1: A column assembly comprising: a chromatography column comprising a __deformable__ seal defining a fluid passage configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit without the use of a ferrule or a threaded compression screw.

(Currently amended) Claim 3: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is configured to mate with a tapered fluid conduit at a diameter of less than __0.050 inches__.

(Currently amended) Claim 7: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion includes an __included angle of less than 50 degrees__.

(Currently amended) Claim 9: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the __deformable__ seal is formed of a polyimide, polyether-ether-ketone, or a metal. 

(Currently amended) Claim 10: The column assembly of claim 1, further comprising a seal retainer that is removable to allow for removal and replacement of the __deformable__ seal.

(Currently amended) Claim 11: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the __deformable__ seal is configured to maintain a seal against a tapered fluid conduit at pressures __up to 30,000 psi__.
